headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Public Trend Signals
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis and risk assessment tools to improve ClearInstall's local-first lockfile auditing, ensuring safer npm/PyPI installations. Leverage Rust for performance enhancements and AI-driven insights for better decision-making during the installation process.
